coverageRationale: Stratified 30 CPE x 30 CLE to mirror the two professional-education document families the extraction pipeline must serve at parity. Within each kind: 10 clean fixtures establish the baseline; 8 degraded-scan fixtures (casing damage, 0/O substitution, split tokens, table remnants, edge cuts) cover the OCR-noise regime real uploads exhibit; 12 adversarial fixtures (3 per class) target the four known failure modes — ambiguous provider fields (platform/venue/co-sponsor vs accredited sponsor of record), near-duplicate credit values (minutes vs credits, requested vs approved, 50- vs 60-minute hours, rescan duplicates), fractional hours (0.2-7.75), and multi-credit certificates (allocation tables, per-day totals, ethics splits). The 12-entry held-out split (1 clean, 1 degraded, 1 per adversarial class, per kind) preserves every stratum so held-out F1 measures generalization across the full difficulty surface; held-out fixtures are fingerprint-pinned here and leak-checked against all committed prompt/few-shot/tuning corpora by heldout-leakage.ts.
